Lebanon Seizes Explosives Truck, Hezbollah Faces Outrage

Lebanese authorities seized a truck carrying explosives at a checkpoint, prompting an investigation vowed by the Prime Minister. Hezbollah is facing public outrage in Lebanon over the incident and alleged cash payouts. The group has also outlined a financial aid plan for Lebanese citizens whose homes were destroyed.
